techniques.label: parallel-b-standard-41-techniques
techniques.observations: All216 production-color frames inspected in six paired native sheets, covering nine equipped moves/front+side, windup, strike/cast/rest, recovery and idle. Nose, eyes, ears, hood and mask remain stable. Arms, feet and tail move with torso; motion in strikes remains connected.

limits: Local exact-hash review. Techniques select battle mesh only. Jaw/chin exterior is a cloth mask; its rounded silhouette and face opening inspected in front/side idle, attack, cast, hit reaction, death and recovery. Under-mask internal anatomy remains naturally occluded. One fresh216-frame technique capture reviewed; no independent second timing or live authenticated modal claim.
